sample_unit: ECG exams (CODE-15% external validation; PTB-XL fold 10 n=2,198)
models_evaluated: per-lead 1D-ResNet encoder with per-diagnosis attention (M0 standard training)
M2 masking plus guideline-based attention guidance (KL penalty)

links.outcome: AUROC robustness of ECG classifier to lost leads, masked versus standard training
links.effect: Standard model M0 tolerated 7 lost leads before AUROC fell >0.02; masked M1 tolerated 10; M1−M0 = +0.0134 (95% CI +0.0102 to +0.0172) when one key lead was lost.
links.quote: Masking improved AUROC: M1 − M0 = +0.0134 (95% CI +0.0102 to +0.0172) when one key lead was lost, and the number of lost leads tolerated before AUROC fell by more than 0.02 rose from 7 (M0) to 10 (M1).

unlisted_practices: Random whole-lead masking during training to improve robustness to missing ECG leads
Guideline-based attention guidance (KL penalty toward key-lead map) to inject clinical knowledge

screen.reason: Evaluates model training and architecture methods (random lead masking vs. guideline-based attention guidance) on ECG benchmarks to test model robustness and calibration rather than evaluating an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
